violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety that is registered/licensed with the RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application supplied to PIC at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026

The facility is lacking a 3 bay sink. A sink with at least three (3) compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. Per the PIC, a bus tub with sanitizer is to be used as TEMPORARY FIX for lacking a 3rd bay until proper sink is installed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026

The ceiling tiles in the kitchen are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable (porous office tiles with several cracked/chipped). Ceiling tiles are to be changed to smooth, durable and easily cleanable tiles for a food area. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/20/2026

A couple wall tiles in the (kitchen) area are in poor repair. Observed a hole in wall tile and a missing tile. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/03/2026

A couple wall tiles in the (kitchen) area are in poor repair. Observed a hole in wall tile and a missing tile. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/03/2026

The ceiling in the kitchen is in poor repair. Several ceiling tiles were observed cracked or with holes at time of inspection. Ceiling tiles are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Ceiling tiles must be smooth, durable and easily cleanable. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 01/20/2026

The Refrigerator in the kitchen area was not in good repair. The unit was observed to be maintaining an ambient temperature of 42 to 48 degrees Fahrenheit. At the time of inspection, the unit was observed used for storage of shelf stable items. Unit is not to be used for storage of Time/Temperature Control for Safety Foods until unit is repaired/replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 10/31/2024
